text:
maria: Quick check — who is owning the 11:00 release train wave? We have backend v2, runtime perf patch, and docs site change. Need smoke owner + rollback plan.
kevin: I can take backend v2, 11:00-11:20. Will run smoke for /api/generate, /api/batch and auth flows.
ashley: I'll own the runtime perf patch, grabbing 11:20-11:35. Canary at 10% then ramp if good.
sanchit: Docs site deploy ok to do last, put me at 11:40-11:50. Need a short route-freeze on docs infra during that window.
kevin: @ashley please include KV cache warmup in your smoke. And ping me when backend health-checks flip green.
ashley: noted. I'll run warmup + p95 latency check. Also confirming canary rollback toggles exist.
maria: Rollback artifacts are pre-built and tagged: backend: backend-v2-rollback-3310, runtime: runtime-perf-rollback-3310. Docs rollback is static revert commit.
deploy-bot: scheduled sequence saved: backend-v2 -> runtime-perf -> docs-site. Canary: runtime-perf @10%. Preflight window: 10:45.
kevin: CR #4521 for backend approved. I will watch error budget and abort if errors >0.5% over 5m.
ashley: Will post smoke outputs in-thread. Using template below so ops can fast-check:
```
SMOKE: ok/failed
p95 latency: 120ms
errors: 0/1000
canary-traffic: 10%
notes: warmup done, KV hit-rate 98%
```
sanchit: Request: small route freeze on docs infra 11:30-11:50 (no new client-side pushes). Can the web squad avoid merges in that window?
maria: Marking calendar and adding route-freeze to the release doc.
kevin: One more: if backend latency >250ms after deploy, I'll trigger rollback. Ashley — are your rollback steps idempotent?
ashley: Yes — runtime rollback is a single fast toggle and revert to runtime-v2.2 image; I've tested in staging.
maria: Final assignment summary: backend owner @kevin (11:00-11:20), runtime owner @ashley (11:20-11:35, canary 10%), docs owner @sanchit (11:40-11:50). Rollback leads: backend=kevin, runtime=ashley, docs=sanchit.
kevin: I'll be on-call for backend rollback and will post health-checks here.
ashley: ack. I'll post the canary metrics immediately after my slot.
sanchit: ack. Will hold off any docs merges until 11:50.
maria: I'll run the 10:45 preflight and post a ✅ or ❌ in this thread. Everyone confirm by 10:40 so I don't have to reassign.
ashley: confirm by 10:40 — ack.
kevin: ack 10:40.
sanchit: ack 10:40.
maria: thanks team — will update release-train doc and add the rollback tags to the ops checklist.
